problem_text:
A shipping company needs to select packages for a cargo shipment. The available packages are:
* Package A: size 25 cubic feet, revenue $294
* Package B: size 20 cubic feet, revenue $130
* Package C: size 25 cubic feet, revenue $187
* Package D: size 25 cubic feet, revenue $251
* Package E: size 33 cubic feet, revenue $166
* Package F: size 27 cubic feet, revenue $218
* Package G: size 7 cubic feet, revenue $88
* Package H: size 10 cubic feet, revenue $12
* Package I: size 38 cubic feet, revenue $274
* Package J: size 7 cubic feet, revenue $114
* Package K: size 39 cubic feet, revenue $272
* Package L: size 8 cubic feet, revenue $146
* Package M: size 45 cubic feet, revenue $96
* Package N: size 25 cubic feet, revenue $53

The cargo container has a maximum capacity of 233 cubic feet. Choose the package combination that yields the highest total revenue without exceeding this capacity limit. Each package must be either fully accepted or rejected.
